answer: One concrete mechanism: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because vine only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, nectar is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any saffron approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
